description: Turn plain text into a clean, printable A4 PDF. Add a title, pick a font size, and your text is wrapped automatically across as many pages as needed.

faqs.a: As many as it takes. Long text flows onto additional A4 pages automatically with the same margins and formatting.
faqs.q: What if my text is longer than one page?

faqs.a: The PDF uses the standard Helvetica typeface, which prints cleanly on any device and needs no special fonts installed.
faqs.q: Which font is used in the PDF?

faqs.a: Your text stays in your browser. The PDF is generated locally and nothing is uploaded anywhere.
faqs.q: Is my text uploaded to a server?

howto: Type or paste your text into the box.
Optionally add a document title and choose a font size.
The A4 PDF downloads automatically, with long text flowing onto extra pages.
title: Text to PDF
